tools.name: client.chain
tools.description: Execute procedures sequentially

steps.description: The steps, in order: calls or values. A step can read an earlier result as { $ref: name } or { $ref: "$last" }.

passThrough.description: Give each step that has no input the result of the step before

initialInput.description: The input of the first step when passThrough is true

tools.name: client.parallel
tools.description: Execute procedures in parallel

tasks.description: The tasks to run at the same time: calls or values

concurrency.description: The most tasks that run at the same time (default: all)

failFast.description: Stop at the first error (default: false)

tools.name: client.conditional
tools.description: Conditional execution (if/then/else)

condition.description: The condition: a value or a call. A truthy result runs then, a falsy one runs else.

then.description: The program for a truthy condition

else.description: The program for a falsy condition (default: undefined)

tools.name: client.and
tools.description: Short-circuit AND (returns first falsy or last value)

values.description: The operands, in order: values or calls. The evaluation stops at the deciding value.

tools.name: client.or
tools.description: Short-circuit OR (returns first truthy or last value)

values.description: The operands, in order: values or calls. The evaluation stops at the deciding value.

tools.name: client.not
tools.description: Logical NOT of a value

value.description: The value to negate. This procedure does not run a call: a call is an object, thus truthy.

tools.name: client.all
tools.description: Returns true if all values are truthy

values.description: The values to evaluate. This procedure does not run calls: a call is an object, thus truthy. client.and and client.or run calls.

tools.name: client.any
tools.description: Returns true if any value is truthy

values.description: The values to evaluate. This procedure does not run calls: a call is an object, thus truthy. client.and and client.or run calls.

tools.name: client.none
tools.description: Returns true if all values are falsy

values.description: The values to evaluate. This procedure does not run calls: a call is an object, thus truthy. client.and and client.or run calls.

tools.name: client.map
tools.description: Map over an array: run fn for each item (the item is { $ref: "item" })

items.description: The array, or a call that gives it

fn.description: The call to run for each item. It reads the item as { $ref: "item" } (or the name in as) and the position as { $ref: "index" }.

as.description: The $ref name of the item in fn (default: item)

results.description: Results that were computed before (old form)

tools.name: client.reduce
tools.description: Reduce an array: run fn for each item (acc and item are $refs)

items.description: The array, or a call that gives it

fn.description: The call to run for each item. It reads { $ref: "acc" }, { $ref: "item" } and { $ref: "index" }; its result is the next accumulator.

accumulated.description: A result that was computed before (old form)

tools.name: client.identity
tools.description: Return input unchanged

tools.name: client.constant
tools.description: Return a constant value

tools.name: client.throw
tools.description: Throw an error

tools.name: client.tryCatch
tools.description: Try/catch wrapper for procedures

catch.description: The program or value for an error. It reads the message as { $ref: "error" }.

tools.name: procedure.define

path.description: The path of the new procedure, for example ["tools", "double"]

input.description: The input of that call. It reads the input of the new procedure as { $ref: "input.<field>" }.

$name.description: A name that a $ref can read

aggregation.description: The body of the procedure: a call ({ $proc, input }) that runs, as client.exec runs it, each time the procedure is called

metadata.description: The metadata of the procedure, for example { description, tags }

replace.description: Replace a procedure that procedure.define made at the same path (never a procedure of code)

tools.name: procedure.get
tools.description: Describe a procedure by path or key

path.description: The path, as an array or a dotted key

runtime.description: Only the procedures that procedure.define made

tools.description: The manifest of the registry: each exposed procedure with its schemas and effects

namespace.description: Only the procedures under this first path segment

tools.name: procedure.delete
tools.description: Delete a runtime-defined procedure

path.description: The path of the procedure to delete (only a procedure that procedure.define made)

tools.name: program.check

program.description: The program: a call ({ $proc, input }). The procedure reads it as data: nothing in it starts.

effects.description: The effects that the calls can have. Absent: all effects.

reads.description: The resources that a call can read: names, or "any"

writes.description: The resources that a call can change: names, or "any". An empty list: no change.

destructive.description: False: a call cannot start a destructive procedure

deadline.description: The deadline (the static check does not use it)

capability.description: The capability of the run. Absent: the capability of the caller.

mode.description: exec (the default): the program runs as client.exec runs it. body: as the body of a defined procedure, with input in scope.

direction.description: The direction of the flowchart: TD (from the top down, the default) or LR (from left to right)
